text:
Stony Ground

Seek your

        hard bed, O body

        of silver.

        In one hand roses and in the other

        sour fruits.

From

        "Stony Ground" 1964 - 1968

translation.title: Stony Ground
translation.editorial_note: The source catalog title says 'To a Young Woman in the Park,' but the body displays 'Pedregal,' so the translation follows the body title.
